stages.text: {keys} to move. Fly into each ring.
stages.touchText: Drag anywhere on the field to move. Fly into each ring.

stages.text: {keys} to dash: a burst of speed that also dodges enemy fire. Dash twice; the dash takes a moment to recharge.
stages.touchText: Tap Dash to dash: a burst of speed that also dodges enemy fire. Dash twice; the dash takes a moment to recharge.

stages.text: Your ALTER fires on its own at enemies in range. Destroy the squad.
stages.touchText: Your ALTER fires on its own at enemies in range. Destroy the squad.

stages.text: {keys} switch weapons. Destroy 12 enemies with a beam weapon: beams score CRITICAL hits on heavy plate.
stages.touchText: Tap a hardpoint to switch weapons. Destroy 12 enemies with a beam weapon: beams score CRITICAL hits on heavy plate.

stages.text: {keys} change the aim mode, which picks the enemy your pilot targets. Destroy an enemy in the new mode.
stages.touchText: Tap the aim button to change the aim mode, which picks the enemy your pilot targets. Destroy an enemy in the new mode.

stages.text: Full Arms is ready. Dive into the crowd and press {keys}.
stages.touchText: Full Arms is ready. Dive into the crowd and tap Full Arms.
